================================================================================
Create a publication
================================================================================

CREATE PUBLICATION mypublication FOR TABLE users, departments;
CREATE PUBLICATION active_departments FOR TABLE departments WHERE (active IS TRUE);
CREATE PUBLICATION alltables FOR ALL TABLES;
CREATE PUBLICATION insert_only FOR TABLE mydata WITH (publish = 'insert');

Create a publication of schemas, columns and sequences
================================================================================

CREATE PUBLICATION p FOR TABLE ONLY s.t * (a, b), TABLES IN SCHEMA marketing, CURRENT_SCHEMA;
CREATE PUBLICATION p FOR ALL TABLES EXCEPT (TABLE t1, t2), ALL SEQUENCES;

================================================================================
Alter a publication
================================================================================

ALTER PUBLICATION noinsert SET (publish = 'update, delete');
ALTER PUBLICATION mypublication ADD TABLE users (user_id, firstname), departments;
ALTER PUBLICATION mypublication SET TABLE users (user_id, firstname, lastname), TABLE departments;
ALTER PUBLICATION sales_publication ADD TABLES IN SCHEMA marketing, sales;
ALTER PUBLICATION p DROP TABLE t;
ALTER PUBLICATION p SET ALL TABLES;
ALTER PUBLICATION p OWNER TO u;

================================================================================
Create a subscription
================================================================================

CREATE SUBSCRIPTION mysub
         CONNECTION 'host=192.168.1.50 port=5432 user=foo dbname=foodb'
        PUBLICATION mypublication, insert_only
               WITH (enabled = false);
CREATE SUBSCRIPTION s SERVER foreign_server PUBLICATION p;

---

ALTER SUBSCRIPTION mysub SKIP (lsn = '0/14C0378');
ALTER SUBSCRIPTION mysub ADD PUBLICATION a, b;

================================================================================
Create, alter and drop a user mapping
================================================================================

CREATE USER MAPPING FOR bob SERVER foo OPTIONS (user 'bob', password 'secret');
CREATE USER MAPPING IF NOT EXISTS FOR CURRENT_USER SERVER foo;
ALTER USER MAPPING FOR bob SERVER foo OPTIONS (SET password 'public');
ALTER USER MAPPING FOR USER SERVER foo OPTIONS (DROP password);
DROP USER MAPPING IF EXISTS FOR bob SERVER foo;

---

================================================================================
Create a foreign table
================================================================================

CREATE FOREIGN TABLE films (
    code        char(5) NOT NULL,
    title       varchar(40) OPTIONS (column_name 'name') NOT NULL,
    did         integer
)
SERVER film_server OPTIONS (table_name 'films');

---

  (create_table_statement

================================================================================
Create a foreign table as a partition
================================================================================

CREATE FOREIGN TABLE measurement_y2016m07
    PARTITION OF measurement FOR VALUES FROM ('2016-07-01') TO ('2016-08-01')
    SERVER server_07;

================================================================================
Import a foreign schema
================================================================================

IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA foreign_films LIMIT TO (actors, directors)
    FROM SERVER film_server INTO films OPTIONS (import_default 'true');
IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA s EXCEPT (t) FROM SERVER f INTO l;
